name: Guangdong Modern High-tech Fiber Co., Ltd
summary: Guangdong Modern High-Tech Fiber Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of polypropylene fibers. Its products include modern polypropylene microfibers, differential fiber polypropylene yarns, polypropylene intermingled fully drawn yarns, polypropylene profiled yarns, and polypropylene twisted yarns. The company was founded on September 6, 2013 and is headquartered in Jieyang, China.
